activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
Making and eating breakfast, brewing tea with the kettle
Dressing, packing work bag and checking the day's schedule on the phone
Commuting to the nonprofit community center
Working as community program coordinator: planning programs, answering emails and coordinating with volunteers
Taking a lunch break near the community center
Working: running a community workshop, meeting partner organizations and updating program records
Unwinding after work, resting on the sofa and checking personal messages on the phone
Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating
Clearing the table, washing dishes and loading the dishwasher
Relaxing with a cup of tea and listening to music
Doing personal admin on the computer with the desk lamp on: reviewing program budgets and next week's schedule
Setting out tomorrow's clothes and reading before sleep
